units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:8">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>נשב זיקא וא׳ וכ׳</he> the wind blew and howled between the branches.
<cite ref="Berakhot 50a:14">Ber. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>וכ׳ איידי דאוושו</he> because all shouted, the prayer was not heard.
Ib. אוושו כ״ע ברכו they all shouted ‘bar’khu’.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 97b:3">Erub. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>אוושא מילתא</he> the thing grows loud, becomes known.
<cite ref="Chullin 46b:10">Ḥull. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>ריאה דא׳</he> lungs which give out a sound when blown up (indicating perforation).
<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:10">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>כי קא אוושא</he> (Ms. M. <he>שמעו קל א׳</he>) when shouting was heard.

senses.gloss: to swell, to be large, fulsome, lengthy (in wording).
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 35a:5">R. Hash. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דאוושי ברכות</he> (Ms. M. <he>קראי …</he>) because the benedictions are numerous and lengthy.
<cite ref="Nedarim 2b:13">Ned. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>הלין דא׳ וכ׳ משום</he> because the last named propositions are lengthy, he explained first what he had commenced with.
